AW-STUDY-0043 · Roster for your read-ahead

Meshy hero characters

First up: the Moon astronauts for the FPS, each in two looks side by side, plasticine claymation and painterly. Behind them, the 40 smooth PG base bodies and the story heroes. None has been run in Meshy yet. Each one gets a Midjourney turnaround first, then one Meshy run, then our Blender cleanup, gear and a rig.

Run in Meshy 0 of 69Credits spent 0Pictures picked 0Next: Meshy on your "go"

Moon astronauts, two looks

Each crew member four ways: plasticine (handmade stop-motion clay, run untextured and shaded as clay in the game) and painterly (hand-painted brush strokes, run with Meshy's paint on), each in the full uniform and in the snug t-shirt and shorts worn under it. Hands empty, no helmets, so Meshy gets a clean body. The look is ours; no studio's characters are copied.

How each hero is made

  1. A Midjourney turnaround (front, side, back) on your Mac. Fast while you're around, Relax when you're not.
  2. One Meshy image-to-3D run, untextured, 20 credits. Your Mac copies the key from the clipboard; it is never saved.
  3. Our cleanup: weld, cut into named body rings, rebuild at 6,000 to 12,000 faces, real material names.
  4. The gear kit fits it automatically, then a rig with proper weights for Character Studio.
  5. Every model goes on one page beside its picture, spinnable, same camera.
